title: Cold Email Structure Checker
one_line: Audit a cold email draft against a seven point outbound framework and return a pass or fail scorecard with a rewritten version.
description: Audit a cold email draft against a seven point outbound framework and return a pass or fail scorecard with a rewritten version. Use whenever someone pastes a cold email and asks whether it is good, whether it will get replies, or asks for a review of outreach copy.
paragraph: Most cold emails fail on structure before they fail on wording. This skill scores a draft on seven checks that are each objectively decidable, returns the scorecard, then rewrites the draft so every failed check passes without inventing facts the sender did not supply.
requirements_summary: Needs no account, key or paid service: it works from the files, exports and answers you give it.
